description: I'm a Sri Lankan student passionate about astronomy, space science, physics, and emerging technologies. I have interests in scientific research, AI, web development, and innovative engineering concepts. I'm currently exploring FLAMEGUARD, an AI-powered fire safety concept based on NASA microgravity combustion research. I'm looking for teammates skilled in Python, AI/ML, data science, physics, and UI/UX design who are interested in building impactful space science solutions.
